description: This file defines an Android activity class 'GameControllerInput' which demonstrates processing game controller input events, tracking device states, and updating UI elements accordingly. It also handles device attachment, detachment, and reconfiguration events, and showcases how to log input events like button presses and joystick movements.

classes.name: GameControllerInput
classes.description: Main activity class that manages game controller input events, device state tracking, and UI updates.

classes.name: InputDeviceState
classes.description: Tracks axes and key states for a specific input device.

classes.name: SummaryAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying device status, axes, and keys in a list view.

classes.name: SummaryAdapter.Item
classes.description: Abstract base class for list items representing headers, axes, or keys.

classes.name: SummaryAdapter.Heading
classes.description: Represents a heading item in the list.

classes.name: SummaryAdapter.TextColumn
classes.description: Represents a text item displaying device or input information.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes input manager, UI, and registers device listener.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers input device listener and enumerates current devices.

methods.name: onWindowFocusChanged
methods.description: Requests focus for the game view.

methods.name: dispatchKeyEvent
methods.description: Handles key events, updating device state and logging key presses/releases.

methods.name: dispatchGenericMotionEvent
methods.description: Handles joystick motions, updating device state and logging axis movements.

methods.name: getInputDeviceState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the InputDeviceState for a given device ID.

methods.name: onInputDeviceAdded

methods.name: onInputDeviceRemoved
